meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 它把 Resend 邮件适配器复制进 src/channels/ 并注册、装依赖、跑构建和测试;再引导你填 API key、webhook 密钥与发件地址(写入 .env),把你的邮箱设为 owner,并让机器人先给你发一封 hello 邮件。
howto.when: 当你要给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道时接管,例如正在跑 /setup 并选择邮件渠道,或想把邮件作为异步会话渠道时。

say.text: 帮我把 Resend 邮件渠道加到 NanoClaw 上
say.note: 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖

say.text: 发件地址用 bot@yourdomain.com,显示名用 NanoClaw

howto.what_en: It copies the Resend adapter into src/channels/, registers it, installs the pinned package, then builds and tests. It also collects the API key, webhook secret and from-address, wires your email as owner, and sends you a hello email.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw, such as while running /setup and picking an email channel, or wiring email as an async conversation channel.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps

say_en.text: Use bot@yourdomain.com as from-address, name NanoClaw
Wire me@example.com as owner and email me a hello
say_en.note: Registers you as owner, sends the hello
